desktop:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: clean cinematic website background, landscape 16:9, ideally 2560 x 1440 native detail.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the approved green portfolio art direction.
Primary request: remove EVERY piece of typography and interface from this image and reconstruct the natural scene behind it. Remove the name in the top left, navigation in top right, huge red headline, white supporting copy, small descriptor, outlined button and its arrow, the complete bottom three-project index including numbers, separators and rules. Output only the atmospheric architectural artwork.
Invariants: preserve the same full-frame camera, exact architectural arrangement, large mint brushed-metal upright planes on the right, smoked green glass planes, scarlet illuminated doorway at roughly 65% width, thin red edges, red light reflected onto the glossy floor, green leaf shadows, rich deep petrol backdrop, and directional cinematic light. Keep the upper-left and middle-left spacious, dark and naturally textured for later live HTML text. Match the selected scene closely rather than redesigning the architecture.

Avoid: all text, all letters, numbers, logos, watermark, UI, buttons, graphic lines, cars, people, rings or O sculptures. Do not flatten the beautiful floor reflections.
portrait:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: production mobile website background, tall 9:16 portrait, ideally 1080 x 1920.
Input image 1 is the clean approved desktop scene, used as the exact world/material/lighting reference.
Primary request: compose a PORTRAIT version of this same architectural scene for a phone, not a crop of the landscape. Preserve the green metal-and-smoked-glass architecture and vivid scarlet illuminated doorway, red reflected light on a glossy green floor, and soft leaf shadows.
Composition: the upper 45% and upper-left must be spacious dark petrol backdrop for live headline and navigation. Place the architectural planes mostly in the lower-right half, rising from around mid-frame; scarlet doorway around 70% width in the lower half, with beautiful red light and reflections spreading across the bottom. Keep the iconic arrangement recognisable, with clear material detail and a sense of scale. No new subject. Rich green atmospheric depth and cinematic ivory highlights.
Constraints: only decorative environment artwork, no text, no typography, no words, no numbers, no interface, no logo, no button, no watermark, no ring or O. Do not put bright architecture behind the upper-left copy area.
